scripts.db:backup: mkdir -p backups && wrangler d1 export DB --remote --output backups/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql --config apps/user-application/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:tt-info: wrangler d1 time-travel info DB --config apps/user-application/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:tt-restore: wrangler d1 time-travel restore DB --config apps/user-application/wrangler.jsonc
